assumptions.statement: M0–M5 are distinct declared models; no unproved equivalence is assumed.
epsilon>0, alpha>0 for the stated regularizations; fields finite.
Bulk variation assumes flat fixed coefficients and cancellation of every boundary term; variable coefficients require formal adjoints.
Field phase is taken on a smooth nonzero chart; winding on a closed nonzero contour.
M4 has beta,gamma>0, specified k_star and periodic/decaying boundary conditions; physical calibration is separate.
D3 uses unrestricted free space, fixed nonzero L2 mass, positive gradient and stated curvature energies without an added binding sector.
Fixed-loop locking supplies Gamma,w>0,m,framing/holonomy and longitudinal sector n.
Nearest-integer physical selection would require full n-dependent energy to equal S_lock plus an n-independent term and globally accessible sector minima.
Physical transitions require preparation, boundary injection or a derived amplitude/phase-slip mechanism.
A physical boundary/interface extractor and map into the measured x must define W independently of residual peaks.
Observable O, source/population, response R, background, coordinate and estimator must be specified.
Exact affine observable phase, correctly specified nuisance model and identifiable response/support imply equality of fitted and mean frequency.
O2 uses uniform continuous least squares on [0,1], free amplitude and phase, zero known background and the stated smooth phase perturbation; no empirical input.
Positive dimensionless x/x0; p!=0; signed orientation handled explicitly and same-winding width transfer treated as a premise.
Koide balance is imposed for the norm identities; physical mass/eigenmode identification and thin-shell reduction are separate.
PFF obstruction applies only if u=|A|^2, isolated continuity and the complex gradient rail use the same physical time.
